perks.name: Arrowhead Brake
perks.desc:
Lightly vented barrel.
  •  Greatly controls recoil
  •  Increases handling speed

perks.name: Chambered Compensator
perks.desc:
Stable barrel attachment.
  •  Increases stability
  •  Moderately controls recoil
  •  Slightly decreases handling speed

perks.name: Corkscrew Rifling
perks.desc:
Balanced barrel. 
  •  Slightly increases range and stability
  •  Slightly increases handling speed

perks.name: Extended Barrel
perks.desc:
Weighty barrel extension.
  •  Increases range
  •  Decreases handling speed
  •  Moderately controls recoil

perks.name: Fluted Barrel
perks.desc:
Ultra-light barrel. 
  •  Greatly increases handling speed
  •  Slightly increases stability

perks.name: Full Bore
perks.desc:
Barrel optimized for distance.
  •  Greatly increases range
  •  Decreases stability
  •  Slightly decreases handling speed

perks.name: Hammer-Forged Rifling
perks.desc:
Durable ranged barrel.
  •  Increases range

perks.name: Polygonal Rifling
perks.desc:
Barrel optimized for recoil reduction.
  •  Increases stability

perks.name: Smallbore
perks.desc:
Dual strength barrel.
  •  Increases range
  •  Increases stability

perks.name: Full Choke
perks.desc: Tightened barrel. Reduces projectile spread when aiming down sights at the cost of precision damage.

perks.name: Rifled Barrel
perks.desc:
Ranged shotgun barrel.
  •  Increases range
  •  Greatly decreases handling speed

perks.name: Accelerated Coils
perks.desc:
Speeds up charge.
  •  Faster charge time
  •  Decreases impact damage

perks.name: Enhanced Battery
perks.desc:
Strong battery life.
  •  Increases magazine size

perks.name: Ionized Battery
perks.desc:
Large heavy battery.
  •  Greatly increases magazine size
  •  Greatly decreases reload speed

perks.name: Liquid Coils
perks.desc:
Slower-building charge for higher damage.
  •  Increases impact damage
  •  Slower charge time

perks.name: Particle Repeater
perks.desc:
Improves stability. 
  •  Increases stability

perks.name: Projection Fuse
perks.desc:
Distance optimizations.
  •  Increases range

perks.name: Surplus
perks.desc: Increases handling, reload speed, and stability for each fully charged ability.

perks.name: No Distractions
perks.desc: Aiming this weapon for a short period reduces flinch.

perks.name: Compulsive Reloader
perks.desc: Grants increased reload speed when close to full magazine.

perks.name: Sleight of Hand
perks.desc: Final blows with weapons or abilities while this weapon is stowed increase its handling, stability, and reload speed for a short duration.

perks.name: Dragonfly
perks.desc: Precision kills create an elemental damage explosion.

perks.name: Fourth Time's the Charm
perks.desc: Rapidly landing precision hits will return two rounds to the magazine.

perks.name: Successful Warm-Up
perks.desc: Each final blow increases charge/draw speed.

perks.name: Burning Ambition
perks.desc: Dealing sustained damage scorches the target. Dealing damage to a scorched target inflicts scorch.

perks.name: Slideshot
perks.desc: Sliding partially reloads this weapon's magazine and temporarily boosts range and stability.

perks.name: Adaptive Munitions
perks.desc: This weapon adapts its damage output and effectiveness against energy shields that don't match the weapon's damage type.

perks.name: Turnabout
perks.desc: Using this weapon to break the shield of a combatant or a Guardian using their Super will grant you an overshield.

perks.name: High-Impact Reserves
perks.desc: Rounds at the end of the magazine deal more damage.

perks.name: Box Breathing
perks.desc: Aiming this weapon for a short period without firing grants bonus range and precision damage that resets after firing or exiting zoom.

perks.name: Clown Cartridge
perks.desc: Reloading this weapon randomly overfills it from reserves.

perks.name: Bait and Switch
perks.desc: Deal damage with all equipped weapons within a short time to give this weapon a damage boost.

perks.name: Focused Fury
perks.desc: Dealing a portion of the magazine as precision damage grants this weapon bonus damage. The shot count is reset whenever the weapon is reloaded or stowed.

perks.name: Elemental Honing
perks.desc: Dealing unique elemental damage grants this weapon a stacking damage bonus. This bonus is increased for kinetic weapons.

perks.name: Aggregate Charge
perks.desc: This weapon deals more damage for each elemental debuff applied to the target.
